propositions: The sidecar channel admits gate-run limit fields (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) in _ALLOWED_FIELDS but drops consumed counter fields (requests, tool_calls), so durable gate error records capture the ceiling but not the measurement

Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic argument, resulting in gate errors with no recorded counters, while only the completion-recovery bounded-recovery arm passes a diagnostic

The completion verdict sidecar carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration) while the plan-review sidecar already carries requests and a metrics block, creating asymmetry between the two gate types

Gate-run consumption metrics are recorded locally in .rebar/usage.jsonl but do not survive to the shared ticket store via the sidecar channel, making them invisible to rebar audit show and downstream agents
A failing gate run must persist consumed counters to the sidecar record (not only passing runs) to enable cost visibility in the store for ticket auditing
